title: .doc files from other Word versions: wrong page size, margins, spacing, indents, pagination (user report)
cause: Section/paragraph/character properties and styles not applied; no pagination
fix: Word 97 and 6/95 SPRMs, STSH inheritance, SEP/PAP/CHP/TAP, page layout at physical size; fidelity 3/27 -> 23/27 (all Word-made files pass)

title: Korean .hwp/.hwpx not supported (user report)
fix: HWP 5 / HWPX renderer laid out from Hangul's saved line layout; fidelity 23/23

title: 3D models requested (user request)
fix: three.js renderer for 9 formats; verified in Orca incl. WebGL

title: 3D model off-centre in Orca
cause: Vertical fit used the bounding sphere; canvas size depended on an injected stylesheet
fix: Fit from projected outline, inline sizes, refit on resize

title: Windows installer hung when Orca was closed
cause: Pipe inherited by the launched Orca app

title: Orca 1.4.248-1.4.251 have no plugin install
fix: dev load fallback in installers and CI
